senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. צָדָה) to lie in wait, hunt, catch.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 66:5">Gen. R. s. 66</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 27:30">Gen. XXVII, 30</cite>) <he>מזויין לָצוּד נפשות</he> (not <he>נפשו</he>) armed to hunt lives (to kill, with ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 21:13">Ex. XXI, 13</cite>, a.
<cite ref="I Samuel 24:12">I Sam. XXIV, 12</cite>; v. ‘Rashi’ a. l.).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67:2">Gen. R. s. 67</cite> <he>היה עשו צָד וכ׳</he> Esau caught deer and tied them.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67:2">Ib.</cite> s. 63 (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 25:27">Gen. XXV, 27</cite> sq.) <he>צד את הבריות בפיו</he> he (Esau-Rome) catches men with his mouth (by means of insidious cross-examination in court); <cite ref="Genesis 25:27">ib.</cite> s. 37 <he>צד … בפיהם</he> catches people through their own mouth.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1:15">Deut. R. s. 1</cite> <he>בשעה שיצא לצוד</he> when he went hunting.
<cite ref="Sotah 4b:9">Sot. 4ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 6:26">Prov. VI, 26</cite>) <he>היא תְצוּדֶנּוּ לדינה וכ׳</he> she will chase him to the judgment of Gehenna.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 13:5">Sabb. XIII, 5</cite> <he>הצד צפור למגדל וכ׳</he> he who chases a bird into the tower or a deer into the house.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 14:1">Ib. XIV, 1</cite> <he>הצָדָן</he> he who catches them (on the Sabbath).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> (ref. to Gen. l. c.) <he>צידני צד בבית צד וכ׳</he> a hunter, catching (captivating Isaac’s good opinion) in the house, catching in the field, in the house (by asking), how are tithes given of salt &c.?; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shabbat 106b:9">Sabb. 106ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שבמינו נ׳</he> an animal which belongs to those that are hunted.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 3:2">Bets. III, 2</cite> <he>יודע שנָצוֹדוּ וכ׳</he> he knows that they have been caught on the eve of the festival.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:6">Sabb. I, 6</cite> <he>כדי שיִצּוֹדוּ וכ׳</he> in time to be caught in the net before the Sabbath begins; a. fr.
